_about: Aeschylus in English, translator per title. Complete in two translators: E. H. Plumptre (verse; Tragedies and Fragments) and John Stuart Blackie (verse, 1850; Lyrical Dramas). Also E. D. A. Morshead (verse; House of Atreus 1881 and Four Plays), T. A. Buckley (prose, Bohn), Gilbert Murray (Agamemnon, rhyming verse; Gutenberg clears it as US PD; Murray d. 1957, not PD in life+70 countries). Publication years are given only where checked in the file; Murray's per-play years were not, so they are left out. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row).

aeschylus-plumptre: tr. E. H. Plumptre (verse), all seven plays and the fragments
aeschylus-morshead-atreus: The House of Atreus: Agamemnon, Libation-Bearers, Furies
aeschylus-morshead-four: Four Plays of Aeschylus: Suppliant Maidens, Persians, Seven against Thebes, Prometheus Bound
aeschylus-buckley-prometheus-seven: Prometheus Bound and the Seven Against Thebes
aeschylus-murray-agamemnon: The Agamemnon of Aeschylus, translated into English rhyming verse
tr. Gilbert Murray; US PD per Gutenberg

aeschylus-potter-greek-tragic-theatre: The Greek Tragic Theatre, vol. 1: Aeschylus (new ed., 1809)
aeschylus-swanwick: The Dramas of Aeschylus (4th ed., revised, 1899)
